name: Interior
description: Represents the interior of an object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns or sets the primary color of the object, as shown in the table in the remarks section. Use the RGB function to create a color value. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the color of the interior.

properties.name: InvertIfNegative
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel inverts the pattern in the item when it corresponds to a negative number. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value, containing an XlPattern constant, that represents the interior pattern.

properties.name: PatternColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the interior pattern as an RGB value. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PatternColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the interior pattern as an index into the current color palette, or as one of the following XlColorIndex constants: xlColorIndexAutomatic or xlColorIndexNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ThemeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value, containing an XlThemeColor constant, that represents the color. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: TintAndShade
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that lightens or darkens a color.

properties.name: PatternThemeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a theme color pattern for an Interior object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PatternTintAndShade
properties.description: Returns or sets a tint and shade pattern for an Interior object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Gradient
properties.description: Returns or sets the Gradient property of an Interior object of a selection. Read-only.
